messages:
Maya: Quick sync re: integrations sprint with LangChain / LlamaIndex + gateway teams — want to align on onboarding flow, joint docs, and marketplace listing timeline. Proposed 4-week sprint, public beta at end of month. @Anjali can you confirm partner readiness?

Anjali: 4-week sprint sounds fine from partner side. Partners asked for a minimal gateway adapter + a test harness they can run locally. Do we have a lightweight example we can hand them?

Jordan: I have a tiny demo repo that spins up a gateway shim + Redwood SDK shim. Sharing a link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-demos/tree/main/gateway-shim (work-in-progress). Minimal start command:
```bash
# start local shim for testing
python -m examples.gateway_shim --model redwood/open-7b
```
This uses a mocked routing policy so partners can exercise fallback paths without full infra.

Tom: Heads up — docs for Dedicated/Private need explicit network & auth snippets (VPC peering, SSO config, CORS for gateway callbacks). Also add a short section on model fallback behavior (e.g., open -> quantized variant) so integrations can test expected latencies.

Maya: Good call. Marketplace listing requirements: logo, short description, billing contact, SSO + onboarding docs, and an approved joint announcement date. @Anjali can you gather SSO contact + legal checklist?

Anjali: Will ping legal and the SSO team. I'll ask for a short MSA template and any DPA language we need for embeddings. ETA: EOD Wed.

Legal-BOT: Reminder: partner MSA must include a data processing addendum for embeddings & clarifications on telemetry. Please route DPA requests to privacy@redwood.ai.

kevin-bot: CI: demo-deploy passed in staging-plugins. Snapshot: staging-2026-03-15-09:12. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5543

Jordan: For the compatibility matrix I propose columns: connector (LangChain | LlamaIndex), supported models, quantization supported (q4/q8/fp16), min sequence length, recommended batching size, GPU requirement, tested OS, auth methods (api-key / sso). I'll draft a CSV and put it in the repo under /compatibility.

Tom: Who will own the orchestration test harness (rolling updates + gateway fallback)? We need to validate that a model fallback doesn't break streaming and that KV cache is preserved on rollouts.

Maya: @Jordan take ownership of the compatibility matrix. @Tom, you own the orchestration harness and smoke tests. I'll coordinate announcement copy with marketing and confirm the joint blog cadence.

Anjali: Quick question on hardware partner callouts in the announcement — are we ok mentioning CoreWeave + NVIDIA? Partners prefer being named for credibility.

Tom: Ok to call out CoreWeave and NVIDIA as infrastructure partners. Avoid implying exclusivity or certification that we haven't completed. Also flag the SI pilot with Atlas Systems — they want co-branded setup docs.

Maya: Great. Drafted next steps: 1) Jordan: initial compatibility matrix (CSV) by Tue; 2) Tom: orchestration harness prototype + smoke test by Fri; 3) Anjali: legal + SSO checklist by Wed EOD; 4) Maya + Marketing: draft joint announcement copy by next Mon.

Jordan: Ack — will upload CSV draft to the repo and open a PR.

Tom: Ack — will spin up harness in staging and add smoke tests for fallback and streaming.

Anjali: Ack — pinging legal now.

Maya: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, drop it in this thread or DM me. Planning a 30m sync Thursday to review PRs. :thumbsup: :calendar:

kevin-bot: Reminder: Thursday 30m sync scheduled at 10:00 PDT. Calendar invite sent.

Maya: Perfect — see you all then. :wave:
